market_holds: Spot $14.30 (sealed baseline, 2026-11-09 18:10 UTC). Options price an event move of about 6.5% (front-expiry straddle 14.5% over 11 days, net of ordinary vol), with 25d skew -3.6 vol points, so upside is the side being paid for; put/call OI 0.72. Run-up: +16.3% over 5 sessions (from $12.07 on 11-03), -5.4% over 20, -50% from the 52-week high. The 5-day rally lines up with a China autonomy/EV sector move (PONY +6.3%, XPEV +6.7%, LI +5.1%, RoboSense +6.5% on 11-06, own Yahoo bars), not with anything Hesai published. Consensus Q3 revenue about $159.5M (Earnings Whispers / Finviz preview, 2026-11-03), roughly RMB1.08bn at the Q2 FX rate, so the Street already sits below the company's RMB1.10-1.15bn guide. One broker (2026-10-22) has Q3 at RMB1.05bn with lower lidar shipments and cut FY26/27 revenue to RMB3.72bn/4.86bn on softer ADAS demand and weaker lawn-mower orders. Nasdaq shows FY26 and FY27 EPS revised down 3 of 3 in the last four weeks. Guides still standing: Q3 shipments 800-850k units, FY 3.0-3.5M units (H1 was 1.10M), SGI RMB200-300M, gross margin close to 40%. Short interest 8.2M ADS on 10-15, 7.3 days to cover. Last three US print days all fell: 2026-03-05 -6.4%, 2026-05-19 -9.0%, 2026-08-18 -5.3% close (gap -12.8%) on a Q3 guide below the Street.
view: The quarter itself looks weak, and the freshest data says weaker than the company guided. Gasgoo's China passenger-car lidar installs put Hesai at 1,055,637 for Jan-Aug, against 928,870 for Jan-Jul and 700,466 for H1. That gives about 127k installs in August, roughly a 25% share of an August market near 500k, while Huawei took about 42% (my arithmetic). Hesai's share was 31-34% in the cumulative tables. July-August together come to roughly 286-355k installs, about 29-35% of the market. H1 ADAS shipments ran 1.09-1.2x domestic installs. Even allowing for a strong September, Q3 ADAS shipments of around 450-600k fit the data better than the roughly 620-650k the 800-850k total guide needs. Robotics lidar is unlikely to fill the gap with lawn-mower orders soft. Li Auto, the biggest ADAS customer, delivered 29,025 in October (-8.6% YoY), its lowest since February. RoboSense's record Q3 (ADAS 450k, +53% QoQ) and Xiaomi adding RoboSense point to share loss. So expect shipments below guide, revenue at or under the low end, and the FY 3.0-3.5M unit target unreachable without a Q4 above 1.2M. Much of this is already in estimates, though: consensus is below the guide, a broker forecast RMB1.05bn, and every FY revision in the last month was down. What decides the reaction is the Q4 revenue guide and how management handles the FY unit target, against a stock that has fallen on each of its last three prints and just rallied 16% on sector beta. Pulling the other way are a crowded short (7 days to cover), call-side skew, sentiment near lows (12% bullish), and a physical-AI/SGI story (Sharpa cap tripled, Kosmo first revenue) that management will push hard on a 07:00 ET call, inside the window. I lean down, but not enough to act.
unpriced: Partly unpriced: the size of the Q3 shipment shortfall and the near-certain FY unit-target cut. The market knows Q3 is soft, but the Gasgoo August share (about 25%) was published 2026-10-31 and I found no preview quantifying it. The 5-day run-up came from sector beta, not news, so the price has moved away from that data. This is not strong enough to call, because estimates were cut hard and the short base is heavy.

recommendation.reason: Fresh install data (Gasgoo Jan-Aug, published 2026-10-31) and Li Auto's October deliveries point to Q3 shipments below the 800-850k guide and an FY unit-target cut. A sector-driven 16% run-up took the stock into the print. But consensus is already below the guide, estimates were cut 3 of 3, and a 7-days-to-cover short base raises the odds of a relief squeeze. Direction-right probability is about 59%, under the 65% bar.
recommendation.what_would_flip_it: A Q4 revenue guide of about RMB1.3bn or more (or an FY 3M+ unit target reaffirmed with Q3 shipments near 800k), plus SGI revenue clearly above the RMB80-100M 'high 8 digits' run-rate. That would make this a relief print against a crowded short.

self_critique: The strongest case against: everything bearish I found is the kind of thing sell-side analysts track. Consensus already sits below the guide, revisions are 3/3 down, and sentiment is at 12% bullish. With 7+ days to cover, the print may only need to be less bad: a Q4 guide around RMB1.2bn+, gross margin at about 40%, and SGI and Kosmo revenue beating 'high 8 digits'. Management will lead the 07:00 ET call with physical AI. Gasgoo's cumulative tables are internally inconsistent (H1 labels swapped between narrative and table), so the August share estimate could be off by several points. Domestic installs also miss overseas and robotaxi shipments. Options paying upside skew may mean positioned money expects a squeeze. That case is strong enough that I moved p_up toward 50 once (from about 38 to 41) and do not recommend.
approach_notes: P3's 'freshest data first' paid: the Gasgoo Jan-Aug table (2026-10-31) and the run-up decomposition against peers were the most useful steps. P4 helped me show that the Q3 miss is in consensus rather than assume it. What I could not get, a Q4 consensus number, is what this print turns on, and the playbook gives no route for foreign issuers with thin public consensus.
